payload.body: Merge ritual for nahel main (Jim, 2026-07-28): bump the semver version — package.json is the ONLY place since PR #18 made src/cli.ts import it — then bun run install:local and verify nahel --version plus a real-store read. Reason: the installed binary is a compiled snapshot; a stale one rejects new config keys with unrecognized_keys errors, which forced a session-long shim workaround during Phase 2.
